name: The Dormant Shade
summary: A dark rite waits at Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. Set a mystic candle on an old, blood-soaked table to summon Lillith Nefara, a Scourge agent, and prove to Gunther Arcanus that you oppose the Lich King.

sections.title: A Gruesome Altar
sections.body: On Gunther's Retreat, an island in Brightwater Lake, a battered dinner table lies stained with blood. The table is no ordinary abandoned piece of furniture. It is the focus of a dark conjuration, a rough slab where dried gore marks the place death and dark magic gather.

sections.title: The Candle of Beckoning
sections.body: Place the Candle of Beckoning on the bloodied table and light it, and Lillith Nefara's spirit answers from beyond death. The flame calls the Scourge agent out of her rest, bringing her into a test for those who seek to prove their allegiance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of lighting the candle on the table?
faq.answer: Lighting the Candle of Beckoning on the battered, bloody table summons Lillith Nefara, a dangerous shade you must defeat.

faq.q: Who is summoned by this ritual?
faq.answer: The ritual summons Lillith Nefara, an undead spirit and Scourge agent who haunts Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: How does this relate to proving allegiance to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Summoning and defeating Lillith Nefara proves to the reclusive Gunther Arcanus that you oppose the Scourge and serve no purpose to the Lich King.

faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?
faq.answer: The ritual takes place at Gunther's Retreat, Gunther Arcanus's island in Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. A battered dinner table stained with dried blood sits just off the island's southern coast.
Anyone with the Candle of Beckoning who undertakes the Forsaken's trials of allegiance can light it on the altar.
The table is an old, bloody altar used by the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara. Lighting the Candle of Beckoning there wakes her from her rest.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you perform a grim rite over a bloodied altar in Tirisfal, where death and dark magic mark your new existence and loyalty to the Dark Lady.
As a warlock, you know the power of binding spirits to blood-drenched altars. This rite tests your hold over the boundary between life and death.
As a priest, you recognize the candle's shadowed call, drawing a lingering soul back into conflict.
